milestones.label: RSU: Medicine and Dentistry applications open
SSE Riga: admissions test
milestones.note: Mathematics, logical reasoning and English, about four hours. Top performers are interviewed 11–28 May.

milestones.label: RSU: applications close for non-EU/EEA applicants
SSE Riga: results for EU applicants
RSU: applications close for EU/EEA applicants
milestones.note: Medicine, Dentistry and International Business & Start-up Entrepreneurship. Five days before IB results.

milestones.label: Turība: autumn intake applications close
milestones.note: Published as "February 1 to August 1" with no year. The one window found that stays open after IB results.

milestones.label: Every other institution: its own closing date
milestones.note: There is no central application for international students. Check each programme page.

supplementarySteps: Apply to each institution separately; there is no shared portal or ranking of choices.
Budget time for recognition of your diploma by the Academic Information Centre — it is a step in every application.

notes: Not established: 2027 closing dates at the University of Latvia, Riga Technical University, LBTU, Ventspils, Liepāja, the music academy and TSI. rtu.lv and liepu.lv return 403 to automated requests.
